title: 姆巴佩巅峰期：弃耐克转投On，股权成关键筹码
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Well, another blow for Nike Killian Mbappe signing on with On as the brand mounts a bold challenge to both Nike and Adidas in the football industry.
segments.zh: 对耐克来说，这又是一次打击。姆巴佩签约On，该品牌正大胆挑战耐克和阿迪达斯在足球领域的地位。

segments.en: It comes just ahead of Nike's removal from the S&P 100.
segments.zh: 此时正值耐克被移出标普100指数。

segments.en: Here with more as Bloomberg senior sports reporter, Brando Williams.
segments.zh: 彭博高级体育记者布兰多·威廉姆斯带来更多分析。

segments.en: Just to put a fine point on it in soccer, there was Adidas, there was Nike.
segments.zh: 在足球领域，过去只有阿迪达斯和耐克两大巨头。

segments.en: What is On trying to do here? Yes with the sponsorship and just more broadly.
segments.zh: On想在这里做什么？是的，通过赞助，以及更广泛的布局。

segments.en: Well, it's an impact statement for sure, because Mbappe is the World Cup's leading all-time goal scorer.
segments.zh: 这无疑是一个影响力宣言，因为姆巴佩是世界杯历史最佳射手。

segments.en: He is one of the most famous athletes in the world and he's in his prime.
segments.zh: 他是世界上最著名的运动员之一，而且正值巅峰。

segments.en: Athletes, the thing that I can't really get past is athletes generally don't leave Nike in their prime.
segments.zh: 运动员通常不会在巅峰期离开耐克，这一点让我难以释怀。

segments.en: Only people who have are Simone Biles, Roger Federer.
segments.zh: 只有西蒙·拜尔斯、罗杰·费德勒这样做过。

segments.en: I once upon a time, Steph Curry, but Steph still had some room to grow in 2013.
segments.zh: 还有曾经的斯蒂芬·库里，但2013年时库里仍有成长空间。

segments.en: He wasn't 2015, 16 or 2018 Steph, so this is remarkable.
segments.zh: 他不是2015、16或2018年的斯蒂芬，所以这很了不起。

segments.en: I want to talk more about On in a minute, but what does this say about Nike, the position that it's in that they could lose somebody of his caliber and international people?
segments.zh: 我想稍后再多谈谈On，但这对耐克意味着什么？他们可能失去他这种级别和国际影响力的人。

segments.en: It makes you wonder going forward, like they do have the ability to sign superstar athletes.
segments.zh: 这让人不禁思考未来，他们确实有能力签下超级明星运动员。

segments.en: But as superstar athletes and they grow to their start and let's say grows even brighter, do they consider Nike the best form of business in Mbappe has decided that he'd like to pursue something different?
segments.zh: 但随着超级明星运动员成长，假设他们更加耀眼，他们会认为耐克是最好的商业形式吗？姆巴佩已决定追求不同的东西。

segments.en: It's a problem with saturation that Nike simply has too many athletes that they are working with.
segments.zh: 这是饱和问题，耐克合作的运动员太多了。

segments.en: I'm just kind of curious what he's being offered, what Mbappe is being offered by on its so appealing.
segments.zh: 我只是好奇On给他提供了什么，姆巴佩被On提供的条件如此吸引。

segments.en: Well, yeah, money, I'm sure. Money for sure, but also equity, and I think equity is a part of things.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的，钱，我肯定。肯定有钱，但也有股权，我认为股权是其中一部分。

segments.en: Now, of course, there's a risk in taking equity that if the company goes south and you probably should have taken a check.
segments.zh: 当然，接受股权有风险，如果公司表现不佳，你可能本该拿现金。
